mechanism: Additive CNS depression from lorazepam combined with potential serotonergic effects and MAOI-related sympathomimetic sensitivity; lorazepam may potentiate the effects of isocarboxazid on the central nervous system.
action: Use with extreme caution; if combination is necessary, start with lowest lorazepam doses, monitor closely for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and serotonergic symptoms; avoid in patients with hemodynamic instability.
